headlines.title: Inflation still a headache for consumers despite cooling last month
headlines.description: Prices rose 0.4% in October, after the average cost of gas eased, bringing some relief to consumers who have been hammered by high prices for most of the year.

headlines.title: Amazon’s Ring debuts security robots including a drone
headlines.description: Amazon’s Ring has launched an indoor security drone, the company said Tuesday, offering homeowners room-to-room surveillance where a fixed camera cannot reach.

headlines.title: Trump Media cashes in on high-speed access to social media posts
headlines.description: The firm’s revenue jumped more than 200% after it started selling a direct feed of posts from Truth Social, whose most prominent user is President Trump.

headlines.title: Nvidia opens investigation after CEO’s affair with alleged Chinese spy
headlines.description: Huang acknowledged being unfaithful to his wife in an employee memo. The board said it has no reason to believe national security or company secrets were compromised.

headlines.title: Nvidia shares sink while stock market surges
headlines.description: Nvidia announced it had opened an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang’s relationship with an alleged Chinese spy.

headlines.title: Drone delivers food to stranded chimpanzee after Florida flooding
headlines.description: Workers at Save the Chimps in Florida used a drone to deliver food and supplies to their stranded chimpanzees after historic flooding left sanctuary roads inaccessible. NBC News’ Ryan Chandler reports.

headlines.title: Nvidia CEO investigated in China spy scandal
headlines.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admitted a romantic affair with a woman who U.S. intelligence said is a spy for China. NBC News’ Brian Cheung reports.

headlines.title: Trump: Jensen Huang said 'I had no idea that she was a spy'
headlines.description: During an impromptu press conference, President Trump said that he had spoken to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang earlier in the day after it was revealed that Nvidia's board had launched an investigation into his extramarital affair with an alleged Chinese spy.

headlines.title: What are the national security implications of Jensen Huang's affair with an alleged Chinese spy?
headlines.description: President Trump defended Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang after the company's board announced it was investigating Huang's relationship with an alleged Chinese spy. NBC News' Kelly O'Donnell and Brian Cheung discuss the national security implications of Huang's affair considering his role in the global growth of AI and his vicinity to President Trump.

headlines.title: What Do the Midterm Results Mean for Future of AI Data Centers?
headlines.description: The construction of data centers, those sprawling buildings that serve as the engine for artificial intelligence, was rejected on all but one ballot nationwide during Tuesday's midterm elections. Residents object to the centers' drain on electricity and water, the noise they produce, and to the limited economic benefit to their communities. What impact will this pushback have on the economy and growing tech industry? NBC's Allie Canal shares an inside look in this week’s Sunday Focus.

headlines.title: J.P. Morgan global market strategist on tech stock selloff
headlines.description: Tech stocks in the U.S. steadied after suffering one of their worst routs in years, as investors weighed the prospect of an AI investment slowdown against future gains following broad Democratic victories in the midterms. NBC News' Christine Romans spoke with Jordan Jackson, the executive director and global market strategist for J.P. Morgan, about investment in AI and why he thinks it could be a buying opportunity.

headlines.title: Stock market meltdown over A.I. fears
headlines.description: The NASDAQ fell by more than 5% as big tech companies connected to the A.I. build out led the stock market dramatically lower today. NBC News’ Christine Romans reports on which companies took some of the biggest hits.
